phase.objective: Qualify the canonical Ubuntu guest boot, NoCloud, QMP, key-only loopback SSH, restart, and secret-hygiene path before adding guest mesh behavior.
entryCriteria: F01 is merged on main at 246d551ca7e691a0319a4b30e29d6e4905cd9910 and its exact final head passed the full software/package workflow.
Checked-in profile JSON, packaged guest-init assets, and strict active artifact manifests are the production source of truth.
Non-Podroid artifacts require active manifests; no unused pre-release migration path remains.
The existing host-QEMU laboratory can perform its current bounded UEFI, NoCloud, QMP, and loopback SSH smoke flow.
The phase makes no Android, physical-device, or guest-mesh acceptance claim.
exitCriteria: One bounded command prepares, boots, verifies, records, and cleans up the canonical Ubuntu host-QEMU flow.
The run records exact source, profile, guest-init, Ubuntu image, and AAVMF identities before QEMU starts.
Real QMP running status, NoCloud completion, and key-only loopback SSH succeed independently of guest mesh.
Guest reboot and complete QEMU stop/start return to readiness without replaying one-use bootstrap material.
A redacted secret-residue inspection and machine-readable host-QEMU evidence are reviewed.
All H02A task criteria and the normal repository/Android/package checks pass before H02B or H03 is reconsidered.
